newsitem.title: USA: Rexall Sundown files for 4 million offer.
newsitem.headline: Rexall Sundown files for 4 million offer.

text.p: Rexall Sundown Inc said it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission in connection with the proposed offering of four million shares of common stock.
Of the four million shares, two million are being offered by the company, and two million by certain shareholders.
It said Raymond James, Montgomery Securities and Adams, Harkness & Hill will act as managing underwriters for the offering.
The company said it intends to use net proceeds to acquire complementary products, product lines or businesses and for working capital and general corporate purposes.
